tasks.gr11-photosynthesis-t2: Topic: Photosynthesis. Cover raw materials (CO₂, H₂O, light energy) and products (glucose, O₂), the role of chlorophyll and chloroplasts, the word and symbol equation for photosynthesis, light and dark reactions in simple terms, and factors affecting the rate of photosynthesis (light intensity, CO₂ concentration, temperature). Ask Grade 11 learners to write and interpret the photosynthesis equation, explain experimental starch tests, interpret rate-of-photosynthesis graphs, and distinguish limiting factors.
tasks.gr11-animal-nutrition-t2: Topic: Animal Nutrition. Cover the structure and function of the human alimentary canal from mouth to anus, the role of associated glands (salivary glands, liver, pancreas), the processes of mechanical and chemical digestion, absorption of nutrients in the small intestine (villi, microvilli), assimilation, and blood glucose regulation by insulin and glucagon. Ask Grade 11 learners to sequence digestion steps, relate organ structure to function, and explain hormonal control of blood sugar.
tasks.gr11-cellular-respiration-t2: Topic: Cellular Respiration. Cover the overall equation for aerobic respiration (C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + ATP), glycolysis in the cytoplasm, the Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation in the mitochondria in simple terms, anaerobic respiration pathways (lactic acid fermentation in animals; ethanol and CO₂ in yeast), ATP yield comparison, and oxygen debt. Ask Grade 11 learners to compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration, write equations, interpret investigation results, and explain energy release.
